title: useRouteError
summary: Read the current page request error inside a route boundary.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.body: Takes no arguments and requires RouterProvider. Route ErrorBoundary components are rendered inside that provider.

sections.title: Returns
sections.body: Returns the current snapshot’s Error or undefined. HTTP errors normalized by the application may also have status, statusText, and data; narrow them with isRouteErrorResponse before reading those fields. It subscribes to the error value: changes to loader data or pending state alone do not trigger a render through this hook.

sections.title: Example
sections.body: Keep the boundary in its own route component file and re-export it from route.tsx. The route loader owns requests; the boundary only renders the reported failure.

sections.title: Scope
sections.body: Independent fetcher failures are exposed on fetcher.error and do not replace the page error. This hook is not a general Preact render-error catcher. Await uses its errorElement or an enclosing Preact boundary for rejected promises.
